question: In table tennis, the period during which a ball is in play is called _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__rally__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term rally in table tennis refers to the period during which the ball is in play.
 
• This period starts from the service hit and continues until the ball is out of play.
